entities.summary: David Unaipon was an Aboriginal Australian preacher, inventor, and author who has been widely credited as the first published Aboriginal writer. Born at the Point McLeay Mission in South Australia in 1872, he was the son of the Ngarrindjeri preacher James Ngunaitponi and his wife Nymbulda. Unaipon became a preacher and public speaker, and toured Australia throughout much of his life to speak at schools and churches. He was also an inventor and registered 10 patents between 1909 and 1944.
